# Amazon Web Services (AWS)

> > Cloud computing platform offering scalable infrastructure, AI/ML services, and enterprise solutions across global availability zones.

AWS is Amazon's comprehensive cloud services platform providing compute power, database storage, content delivery, and other functionality to help businesses scale and grow. The platform serves enterprises, startups, and government organizations with services spanning artificial intelligence, machine learning, IoT, and data analytics across a global infrastructure network.

## Key Topics

- AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Cloud Computing
- Global Infrastructure
- Availability Zones
- AWS Free Tier

- Database Storage
- Content Delivery
- Machine Learning
- Blue Origin
